newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed, crude gives some support.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed, crude gives some support.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed on Wednesday.
Gas oil premiums were stable with potential volatile price swings after the record high physical delivery against the Nov IPE contract putting a cap on physical trades.
Naphtha piggybacked crude to higher levels with support from swaps while gasoline trimmed its gains but still ended higher on crude and recent arbitrage trades.
High sulphur fuel dipped lower amid quiet trade, but low sulphur cracked jumped up to $2-3 on cold weather and supplies.
